crop_model.notes: Trained on the public Crop Recommendation Dataset (N, P, K, temperature, humidity, pH, rainfall -> crop label).

yield_model.notes: DOCUMENTED SYNTHETIC/ESTIMATED yield model. Trained on reference average yields scaled by how closely input conditions match each crop's statistical comfort zone, plus an irrigation adjustment. NOT a field-validated real-world yield dataset.
yield_model.limitation: This is an estimate for general guidance only, not a scientifically validated real-world yield prediction.
